objective: Define the approved portable-integrity behavior as deterministic RED tests before any production verifier exists.
deliverable: One focused unittest module plus a worker receipt containing the exact expected RED command, failure signature, and repository before/after identity.
read_scope: fixtures/adaptive-task-orchestrator-write-dag/ (entire fixture, read-only except the declared test file)
write_scope: Automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths outside the repository

authoritative_facts: The user approved Assumptions 1-8 and the v0.4 specification on 2026-08-31.
No production verify_integrity.py file exists when the first targeted RED command is run.
Manifest bytes and package paths are untrusted parser input; expected digests are trusted only after the manifest passes the approved grammar.
The verifier is read-only under a quiescent-package model and must reject observed symlinks and unsupported objects.
Accepted v0.2 and v0.3 package bytes are immutable.
accepted_upstream_results: The clean baseline had 44 passing tests; v0.2 and v0.3 structural validation passed; integrity counts were 100/100 and 65/65.
user_constraints: Standard library only; do not mutate v0.2/v0.3, add dependencies, use the network, push, tag, or publish.
permissions: Edit only the declared test file and automatically cleaned temporary directories.
non_goals: Do not create production code, alter existing tests, weaken the grammar, implement signatures, strict evidence closure, crash recovery, or a second domain.

acceptance_checks: Cover every positive, grammar, path-safety, inventory, digest, ordering, collision, filesystem-object, read-error, repeatability, and read-only behavior required by the approved spec.
Use exact stable finding-set assertions whenever one mutation necessarily produces multiple findings.
Exercise real temporary files by default and bounded test doubles only for deterministic OSError, unsupported-object, and read-boundary replacement cases.
Run the targeted command before production code exists and retain an expected failure caused by the absent implementation rather than malformed tests.
Do not modify any file outside the declared test path.
evidence_required: targeted RED exit status and failure signature
